scope: Retained unmodified POV6.11.02 and Umbrella6.8.00 public/native source only; no credentials, source/profile edits, application execution, build or dispatch.

normal_metadata_path.parameters: For movies, actual movie TMDb ID; episode path additionally exact season/episode. No direct file/url parameter is consumed by ConfigLoader.apply.
source: resources/lib/modules/sources.py:210-255 play_file resolves genuine selected scraper result -> POVPlayer.run
resources/lib/modules/player.py:125-142 make_listitem supplies typed actual metadata and IDs
normal_metadata_path.gate: Available internal scrapers are five account-backed clouds, Easynews and AIOStreams; no native local-library/offline-file scraper appears in the current internal scraper set. External torrent scraping is disabled when no enabled debrid torrent service exists.

legitimate_downloaded_file_path.metadata: folder_navigator emits actual local file URL, cleaned filename label and fanart; no movie/episode InfoTag or unique IDs are assigned.
legitimate_downloaded_file_path.coverage: Actual existing Kodi file/player events can be exercised. This path bypasses Sources resolution and POVPlayer.run/make_listitem, so it does not establish typed provider playback or debrid/service success.
legitimate_downloaded_file_path.availability: Requires an actual complete lawful film already downloaded to the configured local directory. No such file was installed or selected by this lookup.

source: resources/lib/debrids/aiostreams.py:11-19 Debrid auth and instance URL
aiostreams.credential_contract: The provider explicitly instructs creating an account and entering its instance-specific UUID/password. Public instance means publicly hosted, not anonymous access.
aiostreams.custom_endpoint: aio.instance=1 selects aio.custom_url, but provider documentation says custom URLs are not supported/YMMV. No genuine anonymous compatible service with a real lawful film catalogue was established.
aiostreams.not_claimed: No anonymous HTTP probe or credentials validation occurred. Code sends configured auth; this evidence does not assert a measured HTTP rejection by any instance. A fabricated local AIO response or invented UUID/password would not satisfy this test.

normal_metadata_path.gate: Sources.play returns notification33034 when prem_providers is empty, before local/library source processing. Account/token sources are Easynews, Filepursuit, GDrive, Plexshare or enabled debrid resolvers. Local source retention later in sources.py1194/1348 does not bypass this entry gate.
normal_metadata_path.outcome: Without a genuine configured service account, this normal provider metadata/source path is blocked; no token, setting, resolver result or source was fabricated.

legitimate_downloaded_file_path.behavior: Exposes configured movie/TV download directories as native filesystem folders; does not pass their files through normal Sources.play or the custom provider Player metadata builder.
legitimate_downloaded_file_path.coverage: Actual Kodi local-file playback can be exercised; provider account resolution remains unverified.

supported_raw_url_path.behavior: With no service caller, the branch calls the plain native xbmc.Player.play(url) using only the supplied actual URL. It does not construct provider metadata or call provider Player.play_source.
supported_raw_url_path.coverage: Genuine native playback events only; filename/title alone does not establish a typed canonical movie identity. This route is not evidence that normal Umbrella scraping/accounts work.

film_candidate.description: Night of the Living Dead (1968), proposed public-domain full-film input
film_candidate.reason: No qualifying authless rich provider route was established. Lookup stopped at the account/metadata boundary rather than downloading a film or supplying guessed IDs. A future separate native-file test must independently verify the authoritative movie identity, lawful complete-film source and actual duration before execution.

scope_safe_remaining_option.path: Actual native Kodi movie-library playback of a legitimately obtained complete film, with identity established through genuine library metadata/scraping and exact path matching. A provider download-folder browser may expose that file.
scope_safe_remaining_option.source: Baseline PlayerOperations.cpp175-198 can enrich actual CurrentFileItem by VideoLibrary.FillFileItem using the exact actual playing file path.
scope_safe_remaining_option.limits: This can validate native metadata/events and the existing tracker in a separately selected test. It cannot validate POVPlayer fresh-item metadata, normal Umbrella Sources account admission, premium resolution, AIO service availability, or cross-provider catalogue equivalence. No profile/library seeding is performed or authorized by this evidence.
